**IMPORTANT: Please provide debug-dump**

It is a small icon with down arrow on the front tab / bottom where it say Diagnostics. This information will help with problem analysis. The debug dump is per-session. If you re-start the app after the problem happen, the debug dump will be useless because it is new session.
